title: Worklist tile day-window boundaries
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin (Settings Service), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). These are numeric/date-accuracy cases (Rule 116): seed the exact inputs, read the produced value back, and compare it to the stated value - never eyeball, never accept "a number".
  2. Enrolled assets with services due at fixed offsets from a known "today": -1, 0, +30, +31, +91 and +92 days, plus a Needs-readings service due +200 days. Seed by backdating/forward-dating last-service dates. Compute which tile each falls in by hand first.
custom_steps:
1. With no tile active, read which of the seeded rows appear and which are excluded.
  2. Read which tile each seeded row counts toward at each boundary.
  3. Confirm the +92 row is excluded from the no-tile list and the +200 Needs-readings row is included.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Overdue = due before today (the -1 row); Due in a month = today up to 30 days ahead (the 0 and +30 rows); Due in 3 months = 31-91 days ahead (the +31 and +91 rows); +92 is not listed.
  • With no tile active the list shows overdue / due today / next 91 days plus every Needs readings row whatever its date - so +200 Needs-readings is listed and +92 routine is not.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R2: “The header has four tiles. Overdue: due before today. Due in a month: today up to 30 days ahead. Due in 3 months: 31 to 91 days ahead. Needs readings: per S13-R22”
  • S13-R36: “With no tile active the list shows every row that is overdue, due today or due within the next 91 days, plus every Needs readings row whatever its date. A service further out is not listed”
